Devanāgarī recension: Bohtlingk, Bonn, 1846; Monier Williams, Oxford, 1853, 1876; Burkhard, Breslan, 1872; P. N. Patankar, ‘Purer Devanagari text’, Poona, 1902 (2nd edn.); also Cappeller, Leipzig, 1909, the shorter text.

Southern recension: See edns. under C. s of Śrinivasācārya (1874), Abhirāma, Kāṭayavema etc.
For a collection of variants for the play from Madras mss., see Rev. T. Foulkes, ‘Kālidāsa, A Complete Collection of various readings of the Madras Manuscripts’, Vol. II. (Acts I-V), Vol. III. (Acts VI-VII), 1904.
Eclectic edn.: Saradaranjan Ray, Calcutta, 1908 (6th edn.)., with discussions of controversial passages in different recensions.
Maithilapāṭha: based on mss. in Mythili script, with C.s of Śaṅkara an. Narahari, [Page283-b] Mithilā Institute, Darbhanga, 1957. See Intro. here for a table of differences with other recensions of text. Claimed a. a Maithili recension, but text belongs to Bengali-Kashmiri family, some times leaning towards one, sometimes towards the other.
